== Description ==

[[Casey Anis]] (bald, grey shirt, backpack, peace sign) and [[Emil Wallin]] (tousled brown hair, stubble, and a dark pocket tee; same face as [[:File:2025 European Championship 18.jpg]] and [[:File:2024 World Championship winner and runner-up.jpg]]) at the ''[[Star Wars: Unlimited]]'' Sector Qualifier at Eisbach Studios, Munich, Germany, 1–2 November 2025. It was shared in the album together with the selfie of Anis and [[Timo Dusel]] and shows the same black-draped studio hall.
